summary: S11 tests added; final gates green. All 816 exports passed sr-core; 175 corpus failures are documented with eight ignored regressions.
body:
Changed [sr_core_corpus.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/corpus/crates/interchange/tests/sr_core_corpus.rs) and nine original fixtures under `tests/fixtures/scene/corpus/`: `basic`, `external-matte`, `external-expression`, `fractional-depth`, `generated-id`, `geodesic-camera`, `linked-audio`, `material-override`, and `voxel-palette`. Each fixture is under 800 bytes. Product code and `scene_conformance.rs` are unchanged. Nothing committed; task locks released.

No public API added. Test entry points include `fn sr_core_corpus()`, `fn scene_corpus_required_fixtures()`, and `fn scene_corpus_hostile_documents()`.

Final VM results:

- Clippy with `-D warnings`: passed.
- Interchange tests: **305 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored**.
- Assets: **69 verified**.
- Wasm: **50 crates passed**.
- Corpus: **1,343 cases; 816 imported; 370 refused as expected; 816 exported and oracle-checked; 232 expectation skips; 175 failures; zero product panics**.

The optional corpus lane remains red because of product bugs. [Every failing case, source location, cause, proposed fix, and regression mapping]( /home/admin/src/render-frontend-js/PALS-Notes/projects/ops/filmcraft-scene/agents/corpus/findings.json) is recorded. Evidence: [oracle log](/home/admin/src/render-frontend-js/PALS-Notes/projects/ops/filmcraft-scene/agents/corpus/oracle.log), [final gate log](/home/admin/src/render-frontend-js/PALS-Notes/projects/ops/filmcraft-scene/agents/corpus/gate.log).

The eight ignored regressions are:

| Regression | Corpus failures | Cause and proposed fix |
|---|---:|---|
| `fractional-depth.scene` | 11 | [resolve.rs:1275](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/corpus/crates/interchange/src/scene/resolve.rs:1275) parses geometric z as an integer stacking index. Distinguish 3D depth from 2D stacking. |
| `material-override.scene` | 6 | [overlay.rs:122](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/corpus/crates/interchange/src/scene/import/overlay.rs:122) misses material IDs encoded in strings. Include `materialOverride` dependencies. |
| `external-expression.scene` | 100 | [overlay.rs:49](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/corpus/crates/interchange/src/scene/import/overlay.rs:49) refuses sibling dependencies. Expand to a bounded enclosing overlay while preserving clocks. |
| `geodesic-camera.scene` | 18 | [overlay.rs:152](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/corpus/crates/interchange/src/scene/import/overlay.rs:152) loses the implicit black-hole dependency. Preserve the relevant 3D context. |
| `voxel-palette.scene` | 14 | Overlay closure misses palette material IDs. Include their transitive dependencies. |
| `generated-id.scene` | 8 | [overlay.rs:43](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/corpus/crates/interchange/src/scene/import/overlay.rs:43) requires generated IDs to exist in the DOM. Preserve their generators and defer resolution. |
| `linked-audio.scene` | 18 | [export.rs:407](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/corpus/crates/interchange/src/scene/export.rs:407) retains video audio alongside explicit audioMix tracks. Serialize references so re-import creates each audio clip once. |
| Generated `10000-siblings` | Hostile case | [export.rs:432](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/corpus/crates/interchange/src/scene/export.rs:432) charges default effects and parameters against the export budget. Align admission/export budgets while retaining bounded work. |

Design notes: discovery is recursive and counts files at runtime, including embedded SREP scenes. Pending/unported expectations follow the existing conformance logic, while safety checks remain active. Clip accounting excludes the newly materialized default background described by [XSD projectType](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/corpus/crates/interchange/schema/sr-core/scene-render.xsd:7008); only explicit clip-loss reports excuse missing clips. The public export dispatcher is used because `scene::export::export` is crate-private. Fixture comments cite the relevant XSD declarations and MOV2/BH5/VOX6 rules. No unresolved spec ambiguity or borrowed scene-render code; only existing internal NOT_PORTED logic was reused.

TDD evidence:

- Discovery failed `0 != 3`; fixture and hostile tests failed at the pipeline stub. Implemented helpers now pass.
- The seven reduced fixtures reproduced strict-import failures or audio clip growth `2 → 3`; the hostile test reproduced the export-budget refusal. Product assertions remain explicitly ignored, with safety checks still active.
- The skip-filter test failed “a known diagnostic must never excuse a panic”; the corrected filter passes.
- Final corpus-test binary: **8 passed, 8 ignored** without `SR_CORE_DIR`.

The VM copy lacks revision metadata, so it printed `revision unavailable` alongside the expected pin. Set `SR_CORE_REV` when shipping that copy. After each product fix, remove its ignore and matching `KNOWN_REGRESSIONS` exception, then rerun the corpus.
